Senses.Explanation: The phrase says “face south and look at the Northern Dipper” (面南看北斗); Chan records place this exact directional line in hall addresses and verses. Foyan Qingyuan opens a hall address with “seven sevens are forty-nine” and immediately gives the phrase; Chushi Fanqi pairs it with holding a hoe empty-handed at night. Other retained records place it beside a midday crow and a midnight iron ox, or after lines about Xuefeng Yicun and Yunmen Wenyan. None of the retained witnesses supplies a gloss beyond the south-facing posture and the northern star-name.
